# Timeline

- THR-SYN-001: The orchard bells begin answering one another.
- Day 1, dawn: Mira hears the first bell and meets Jalen at the eastern gate.
- Day 1, morning: the pair find a warm seam between three glass trees.
- Day 1, later: the seam becomes a doorway to an unfamiliar shore.
